stages.name_zh: 接受后捕获结算和读回

algorithms.atr_window: N根连续选中actual产生N个TR值；每项使用当日high/low和前一选中actual的close。最早bar的high/low与最新bar的close不是依赖字段

time_roles.PREVIOUS_ACCEPTED: Exact frozen accepted context, no current-day reverse edge
time_roles.HISTORICAL_WINDOW: Declared market/actual window and coordinate, no unknown-gap skipping
time_roles.FORWARD_DUE: Frozen observation and calendar; accepted followup sources only
time_roles.FIRST_OBSERVATION: Explicit initial/left-censored state, never fabricate prior episode

day_plan_pure_kernel.implementation_scope: 显式上下文到不可变DayPlan候选、正式scope stage/artifact闭包拓扑、增量分类与上游环境状态聚合
day_plan_pure_kernel.contract_digest_canonicalization: UTF-8 JSON; sorted object keys; compact separators
day_plan_pure_kernel.business_input_digest_definition: Canonical JSON SHA-256 over full contract identity, scope revision binding, calendar identity, semantic revisions and exactly the registered values/quality/provenance/parameters/producer fields; unregistered business_identity keys are ignored, excluded metadata keys are recursively omitted with containers emptied solely by those keys, and target/schedule are separate plan identity.
day_plan_pure_kernel.plan_digest_definition: Canonical JSON SHA-256 over contract, scope, business input digest, target, complete frozen context, prior context, environment evidence, incremental decision, parent generation and scheduled session/stage closure after recursive omission of excluded metadata keys and containers emptied solely by those keys.
